observations: Torah LM2:26 is a short, tightly unified teaching. The entire positive domain collapses into one package (Package 1: Da'at/Moshe/Avraham/Chassadim/248 limbs). The evil domain — excessive drinking leading to Gevurot d'Sitra Achra and anger — is described only through eitza (causal) language, not through bechina equivalences. The Rebbe does not equate drunkenness, Gevurot, and anger as expressions of the same essential nature; he says the first produces the second which produces the third. Since packages must be built on bechina (parallel/same-nature) relationships, the evil concepts cannot form a new bechina-based package. Three potential evil nodes (שִׁכְרוּת, גְּבוּרוֹת דְּסִטְרָא אָחָרָא, כַּעַס וָרֹגֶז) are noted in the additions file as implicit evil mirror concepts but do not meet the threshold for a new bechina package. The two proposed additions (חֲסָדִים and מִתְפַּתֶּה) naturally join Package 1 rather than forming any independent domain. Verdict: no new packages are warranted.
